title: Test-first work and isolated test environment
problem: A final green diff cannot establish test-first order or an isolated environment.
rationale: Product profile holds coding dispatch when required test environment is unverified; local hobby can use disposable local fixtures. No production data/credentials in test fixtures.
applicability: Before ordinary coding begins; bootstrap environment repair is separately scoped.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: approved isolated environment/fixture smoke succeeded before coding begins; commands and environment identity are recorded. Red-before-green run receipts can show that a failing test ran before a later change.
target_check.reviewer: that it failed for the intended behavior. A final diff alone cannot prove TDD chronology.
